Date of service: 08/20/2025 | Dr. Petra Draycott, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
39-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hypertension.

Exam:

Treatment history:
